input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit right binding us and it matches the preferred position on every material term: frequency capped at once per twelve months, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours with no unreasonable disruption, off-site where practicable, conducted by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality, Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and an express bar on direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information. Section 22.3 adds customer-favourable protections (findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the final report, and payment of a shortfall closing the issue). No verification, inspection, monitoring or remote-access rights appear elsewhere in the document. Nothing to redline.
